concept: IAM: cross-account read-only role for an external auditor
tests: How to give a third-party auditor read-only access without long-term credentials.
expected: Cross-account IAM role with a read-only policy (e.g., ReadOnlyAccess/billing); the auditor assumes it and gets temporary credentials. Triggers: "third-party auditor", "read-only", "without long-term credentials".
why_not: IAM user with keys sent by email — long-lived secret; root credentials — unacceptable; adding to the management account — excessive permissions.
